title: My town market
instructions: Ayla kasabasındaki pazarı anlatıyor. Gün, saat ve satılanlara dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: There is a big market in my town every Friday.

script.speaker: s
script.text: It opens at eight in the morning and closes at two.

script.speaker: s
script.text: You can buy fruit, vegetables, cheese and clothes there.

script.speaker: s
script.text: My mum and I go every week.

script.speaker: s
script.text: The fruit is fresh and cheap.

questions.evidence: There is a big market in my town every Friday.

questions.prompt: What does Ayla say about the fruit?
questions.evidence: The fruit is fresh and cheap.
